title: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Treatment of Acute and Chronic Heart Failure

definitions.HFmrEF: HF with mildly reduced EF: LVEF 40–49%
definitions.Acute HF: Rapid onset or worsening of HF signs/symptoms requiring urgent therapy
definitions.Congestion: Elevated filling pressures: orthopnoea, PND, peripheral oedema, raised JVP
definitions.Cardiac Resynchronisation Therapy (CRT): Biventricular pacing to coordinate LV contraction

recommendations.text: ACEi is recommended for HFrEF to reduce mortality and HF hospitalization.
Beta-blockers are recommended for HFrEF in stable patients to reduce mortality and HF hospitalization.
MRA is recommended for HFrEF to reduce mortality and HF hospitalization.
Sacubitril/valsartan is recommended as replacement for ACEi in patients with HFrEF who remain symptomatic despite GDMT, to reduce mortality and HF hospitalization.
SGLT2 inhibitors (dapagliflozin or empagliflozin) are recommended for HFrEF to reduce the risk of HF hospitalization and CV death.
ICD therapy is recommended in patients with HFrEF and LVEF ≤35% after ≥3 months of GDMT to prevent sudden cardiac death.
CRT is recommended for patients with HFrEF, LVEF ≤35%, LBBB morphology, and QRS ≥150 ms to reduce mortality and improve symptoms.
Ivabradine is recommended for symptomatic HFrEF patients with LVEF ≤35%, sinus rhythm, resting HR ≥70 bpm on maximally tolerated beta-blocker, to reduce HF hospitalization.
IV iron (ferric carboxymaltose) is recommended in symptomatic HFrEF patients with iron deficiency (ferritin <100 ng/mL or 100–300 with TSAT <20%) to improve QoL and reduce HF hospitalizations.
Diuretics are recommended for relief of dyspnoea and oedema in patients with HF and congestion.
ARB (candesartan or losartan) is recommended for HFrEF patients intolerant of ACEi or ARNI.
Referral for cardiac transplantation or mechanical circulatory support is recommended in Stage D/advanced HF refractory to GDMT.
SGLT2 inhibitors are recommended in HFpEF to reduce the risk of HF hospitalization.

pharmacotherapy.examples: bisoprolol 2.5–10 mg, carvedilol 3.125–25 mg BID, metoprolol succinate 12.5–200 mg, nebivolol 1.25–10 mg
